description: Source code implementing thread flag operations for CMSIS RTOS v2 in Zephyr OS, including setting, getting, clearing, and waiting for thread flags.

methods.name: osThreadFlagsSet
methods.description: Sets specified thread flags for a given thread.

methods.name: osThreadFlagsGet
methods.description: Retrieves current thread flags of the calling thread.

methods.name: osThreadFlagsClear
methods.description: Clears specified thread flags for the current thread.

methods.name: osThreadFlagsWait
methods.description: Waits for one or more thread flags to be signaled, with options for wait-all and timeout.
